verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards service for AI vendor spend. Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS fintech product that holds company and transaction data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions choosing a storage region or data residency; the pack covers only rewards rates, partner perks, card signup and withdrawals.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
